# xormap — Test Results Report

Results from the native C++ ports of the xormap image cipher, generated by
`./run_all_tests.sh` — one combined sweep + statistical-analysis pass per
image format (grayscale, RGB888, RGB565), each producing one CSV and one PDF
report in that project's `results/` directory. Grayscale and RGB888 also run
a key-sensitivity/histogram/PSNR analysis pass alongside the sweep; RGB565
currently has only the sweep pass (no key-sensitivity/histogram analysis).

## Images tested

| Set | Images tested | K values tested | (image, K) rows | Source CSV | Report PDF |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grayscale | 159 | 24:24:384 (16 values) | 2544 | [`xormap_image_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_gray_all.csv`](xormap_image_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_gray_all.csv) | [`xormap_image_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_gray_all.pdf`](xormap_image_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_gray_all.pdf) |
| RGB888 | 51 | 24:24:384 (16 values) | 816 | [`xormap_image_rgb888_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_rgb888.csv`](xormap_image_rgb888_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_rgb888.csv) | [`xormap_image_rgb888_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_rgb888.pdf`](xormap_image_rgb888_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_rgb888.pdf) |
| RGB565 | 51 | 24:24:384 (16 values) | 816 | [`xormap_image_rgb565_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_rgb565_all.csv`](xormap_image_rgb565_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_rgb565_all.csv) | [`xormap_image_rgb565_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_rgb565_all.pdf`](xormap_image_rgb565_matlab_cpp/results/sweep_k_rgb565_all.pdf) |

## Statistical threshold: chi-square uniformity of the cipher histogram (alpha = 0.05)

This is the only column across these results with an explicit accept/reject
statistical threshold (`cipher_uniform_pass`, from a chi-square goodness-of-fit
test against a uniform distribution). Entropy, NPCR, UACI, and PSNR are
reported further down as deviation from their ideal/expected values — the
code does not define a pass/fail threshold for them.

| Set | (image, K) rows passing | Images passing at every tested K | Images passing at ≥ 1 tested K |
|---|---|---|---|
| Grayscale | 2309/2544 (90.8%) | 29/159 | 159/159 |
| RGB888 | 765/816 (93.8%) | 0/51 | 51/51 |
| RGB565 | N/A — no histogram/chi-square analysis pass exists for RGB565 | — | — |

Both grayscale and RGB888 pass chi-square uniformity almost universally at
every K ≥ 48 (90–100%), which is why the raw "images passing at every tested
K" figures above look low: they are dragged down almost entirely by K=24, the
smallest K tested, where the keystream period is short relative to the image
size and the cipher histogram is measurably less uniform. Per-K breakdown:

RGB565 has no `cipher_uniform_pass` column: its `sweep-all` command only runs
the sweep pass (entropy/correlation/NPCR/UACI), not the histogram/chi-square
analysis that grayscale and RGB888 run via `run-tests`.

## Full results

Every row from every `sweep_k*.csv`, verbatim. Column meanings:
- `npcr_plaintext_flip*` / `uaci_plaintext_flip*`: diffusion from flipping one
  **plaintext** pixel bit (same key).
- `npcr_key_flip` / `uaci_key_flip`: diffusion from flipping one **key** bit
  (same image), fixed bit position.
- The per-bit-study table (grayscale/RGB888 only): same key-bit diffusion,
  but on one representative image across many different flipped bit positions.
- `psnr_roundtrip_db` of `Inf` means an exact, lossless decrypt.
- Encryption/decryption timing is intentionally not collected or reported
  (not a security metric; varies with machine load).
